_comment: Gensokyo Directory & Personality Dossier for the Bunbunmaru Newspaper (文々。新聞). The model consults this dossier to ground eyewitness quotes and commercial classifieds in canonical Touhou lore.

interviewees.name: Reimu Hakurei (博麗 霊夢)
interviewees.personality: Lazy, perpetually broke, easily irritated, deeply suspicious of reporters. Values tea, naps, and donations above all else.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Extremely hostile. Constantly threatens to seal or exterminate Aya for shoving cameras in her face without dropping 500 yen in the offering box.
interviewees.speech_style: Blunt, cynical, uncooperative, demanding money for interviews.

interviewees.name: Marisa Kirisame (霧雨 魔理沙)
interviewees.role: Ordinary Magician of the Forest of Magic
interviewees.personality: Enthusiastic, bold, kleptomaniac (she 'borrows until she dies'), loves high-powered explosions and lasers.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Playful but guarded. Always brags about discovering things first and asks if Aya caught her good side.
interviewees.speech_style: Energetic tomboy, ends sentences with casual confidence, brags about Master Spark.

interviewees.name: Cirno (チルノ)
interviewees.role: Ice Fairy of the Misty Lake / Self-Proclaimed Strongest (⑨)
interviewees.personality: Childish, boastful, completely gullible, has zero reading comprehension, claims she is the absolute strongest being in Gensokyo.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Tries to show off, misunderstands Aya's complex vocabulary, insists she can freeze whatever incident is happening.
interviewees.speech_style: Boastful, loud, simple-minded, claims everything is easy for the strongest.

interviewees.name: Sanae Kochiya (東風谷 早苗)
interviewees.role: Moriya Shrine Wind Priestess / Outside World Transplant
interviewees.personality: Optimistic, earnest, slightly unhinged in her quest to gather faith. Still references Outside World mecha anime and pop culture.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Friendly and eager for PR coverage to promote the Moriya Shrine, but gets overly preachy about miracles.
interviewees.speech_style: Polite modern schoolgirl cadence, blends shrine priestess duties with geeky sci-fi references.

interviewees.name: Nitori Kawashiro (河城 にとり)
interviewees.role: Kappa Heavy Industries Engineer & Business Head
interviewees.personality: Pragmatic, secretive, tech-obsessed engineer who loves cucumbers, optical camouflage, and money. Explains anomalies with absurd pseudoscientific kappa mechanics.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Transactional. Won't speak without being paid or granted free advertising space. Denies all rumors of design defects.
interviewees.speech_style: Fast-talking technical jargon, salesman-like, defensive about explosions.

interviewees.name: Sakuya Izayoi (十六夜 咲夜)
interviewees.role: Head Maid of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
interviewees.personality: Impeccably elegant, composed, time-manipulating perfectionist. Coldly ruthless against anyone who disturbs Lady Remilia.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Icy and formal. Answers while subtly polishing silver throwing knives to remind Aya she can stop time at any moment.
interviewees.speech_style: Aristocratic butler cadence, polite threats, utterly devoted to Remilia.

interviewees.name: Remilia Scarlet (レミリア・スカーレット)
interviewees.role: Vampire Mistress of the Scarlet Devil Mansion
interviewees.personality: Charismatically arrogant, theatrical, secretly childish, claims to manipulate fate and that everything is part of her grand crimson design.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Smug and amused. Treats the interview like an imperial audience, demanding dramatic prose in the morning edition.
interviewees.speech_style: Haughty, theatrical, dramatic noble vampire cadence.

interviewees.name: Flandre Scarlet (フランドール・スカーレット)
interviewees.role: Diabolical Vampire Princess in the Basement
interviewees.personality: Unstable, cheerfully terrifying, incredibly destructive. Has the power to destroy anything by clenching her fist.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Innocently creepy. Asks Aya if she can squeeze the reporter's camera until it goes 'boom'.
interviewees.speech_style: Playful child-like voice laced with catastrophic destructive intent.

interviewees.name: Rinnosuke Morichika (森近 霖之助)
interviewees.role: Proprietor of the Kourindou Curiosity Shop
interviewees.personality: Pedantic, intellectual hoarder, philosophical. Has the power to know the name and purpose of Outside World items, but zero idea how to actually operate them.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Long-winded lecture mode. Gives absurd, overly complex theories that are 100% wrong.

interviewees.name: Reisen Udongein Inaba (鈴仙・優曇華院・イナバ)
interviewees.personality: Neurotic, stressed, overworked, easily bullied by Eirin and Tewi. Desperately tries to prevent pharmaceutical scandals.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Paranoid. Thinks Aya is conducting an FDA-style inspection into Eientei's unverified drugs.
interviewees.speech_style: Anxious, apologetic, trying to hide suspicious medicine bottles.

interviewees.name: Youmu Konpaku (魂魄 妖夢)
interviewees.personality: Earnest, easily startled, terrified of ghost stories despite being half-phantom. Extremely loyal to Lady Yuyuko.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Tense and formal. Threatens to cut Aya's questions in half with Roukanken if she suspects disrespect.
interviewees.speech_style: Disciplined samurai apprentice, nervous under pressure.

interviewees.name: Yuyuko Saigyouji (西行寺 幽々子)
interviewees.personality: Whimsical, carefree, enigmatic, and endlessly hungry. Her mind always drifts toward snacks and dining.
interviewees.attitude_towards_aya: Teasing. Completely ignores the incident and asks Aya if the object in the photo can be boiled or grilled.

advertisers.typical_offerings: Mysterious glass bricks (smartphones), silver calculation slabs (laptops), plastic cylinders with black carbonated liquid (Pepsi), mechanical clocks.
advertisers.ad_tone: Scholarly, enigmatic, exorbitant pricing, mentions that proprietor may be reading in the back if shop appears deserted.

advertisers.typical_offerings: Amphibious jetpacks, camouflage cloaks, waterproof drill-arms, automatic cucumber peelers.
advertisers.ad_tone: Aggressive startup tech pitch, boasts low explosion odds (e.g. 'only 35% detonation risk!'), offers free bonus gadgets.

advertisers.business_focus: Religious Services, Amulets & Desperate Faith Campaigns
advertisers.typical_offerings: Exorcisms (50% off if paid in advance), lucky purification rod bromides, sacred spring water (tap water), donation box upgrades.
advertisers.ad_tone: Aggressive guilt-tripping, blames current incidents on lack of donations, promises divine retribution to non-donors.

advertisers.sponsor: Moriya Shrine Faith & Tech Co. (守矢神社)
advertisers.business_focus: Modernized Faith, Nuclear Power & Mountain Tourism
advertisers.typical_offerings: Ropeway aerial cable car tickets, miracle-infused energy drinks, clean geothermal power subscriptions, modern prayer apps.
advertisers.ad_tone: Corporate corporate-speak, aggressive business expansion, guarantees tangible miracles with every contract.

advertisers.typical_offerings: Ultra-vitality stamina draughts, sleepless night study drops, rabbit-ear soothing lotion, unapproved memory-erasing balms.
advertisers.ad_tone: Clinical yet slightly menacing, reminds customers that side effects may include spiritual distortion or lunar madness.

advertisers.sponsor: Scarlet Devil Mansion Catering & Salon (紅魔館)
advertisers.typical_offerings: Crimson black tea sets, private ballroom reservations, fine silverware appraisals, daytime parasol fittings.
advertisers.ad_tone: Extravagant gothic aristocracy, subtly reminds patrons that uninvited gate-crashers will be disciplined by the gatekeeper.
